'''Slumbering Conflux''', which have been crafted before, can be still upgraded into [[Conflux]]. }} [[Slumbering Conflux]] is a [[WvW]]-exclusive [[legendary trinket]] without any visual effect. == Acquisition == === Historical recipes === * After the [[Game updates/2021-07-13|July 13, 2021]] ([[Legendary Armory]] release), these recipes craft [[Conflux]] directly. {{Recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Gift of the World | ingredient2 = 1 Mist Band (Infused) | ingredient3 = 1 Mystic Tribute | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Conquering | status = historical }} {{Recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Gift of the World | ingredient2 = 1 Attuned Mist Band (Infused) | ingredient3 = 1 Mystic Tribute | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Conquering | status = historical }} == Used in == === Historical === {{recipe list}} == Vendors == {{Vendor query table|currency=Slumbering Conflux|showCostText=true}} == Available prefixes == * The following [[Attribute combinations|prefixes]] can be selected: {{prefix selection|all legendary trinket}} == Notes == * Slumbering Conflux was released alongside the [[Visions of the Past: Steel and Fire]] update on [[Game updates/2020-03-17|March 17, 2020]]. * [[Conflux]] provides the same benefits as Slumbering Conflux and additionally has visual effects. * Slumbering Conflux is not added into the [[Legendary Armory]]. * Slumbering Conflux can be exchanged for [[Conflux]] at [[Grandmaster Craftsman Hobbs]].
